method: Read-only review of the complete runtime diff, new modules, tests, persistence/network callers, copied QA and release workflow according to review-agent. Self-review by the implementation agent, not independent.
resolvedFindings: Define wet grip in the race obstacle-braking scope as well as curve planning; native race regression verifies the corrected path.
Keep offline weather separate while a network session is active; restore it on leave.
Initialize the rain draw range to zero before the first renderer update.
Remove a duplicate weather key from lobby normalization before final build.
visualCheck: Final night-rain and daytime wet-road screenshots inspected; rain, vehicle, roadway and driving UI remain visible.
limits: Fictional wet-tyre and water-drag calibration; no fluid simulation or certified real-car braking data.
Road material reacts to existing scene lights; no reflected-scene render or mirror-reflection claim. Showroom is sheltered; future tunnels and garage roofs need appropriate rain occlusion.
Broader handling/controller calibration and all later body/interior/garage/world phases remain tracked.
Multiplayer uses local independent Chromium processes with public PeerJS/WebRTC; separate PCs, mobile networks and TURN traversal not validated.
No physical controller, subjective listening or GPU benchmark. CPU sample excludes world/AI/audio/GPU.
